title: 第7章 雨后山洞杀了人第8章 绘身仙纹下山拜宗
content_zh:
;;
当李观棋踏上第一层台阶开始，顿时吸引了不少人的目光。
这个身后背着一个硕大盒子的少年，竟然没有丝毫的犹豫便踏上了阶梯。
少年双眸位置的黑色布条则是让所有人不由得侧目。
一直垂眸不语的管事猛然睁开双眼看向台阶上的人影。
在他看来那少年身后的石头盒子最少也有二百余斤重！
但是这少年从始至终气息都十分均匀，没有丝毫费力的表现。
管事顿时眼底闪过一抹精芒口中呢喃道。
“如此体魄…怕是已入锻体之境。”
咻！
一道轻微的破空声在少年耳边响起，脚下瞬间发力身形顿时横移一尺。
“咦？”
李观棋站在台阶上对着管事的方向躬身行礼道：“额…这位前辈刚刚是要做什么？”
管事看着少年迅捷的身手脸上笑意更甚了几分。
“小娃娃，不用怕，那只是一个计时的符咒而已。”
李观棋有些尴尬的挠了挠头，原来是计时用的符咒。
管事手指一绕，那黄色的符咒绕着李观棋转了一圈最后贴在了他的胸口处。
管事笑着说道：“去吧，抓紧时间，越早上去越好。”
李观棋顿时嘴角微微上扬，连忙抱拳行礼回道。
“谢过管事，那小子就先上去了。”

管事张了张嘴刚要说什么，却看到少年深吸一口气，脚下发力瞬间犹如一头猎豹一般朝着上方疾驰而去！
“嘶…这体魄！我还想让他把身后的东西摘下来呢。”
一路上李观棋的身旁不断的有人影闪过，被他落在身后。
李观棋低头看向胸口那逐渐消散的符咒，心中估算着符咒消失的时间。
“两个时辰…”
“这一眼望不到头的天梯少说也有几千阶，可不是个简单事儿。”
刚刚他在山脚下走到半山腰，就足足走了接近三个时辰。
实在是前来拜宗的人太多了，粗略一算这大夏剑宗的山脚下起码有接近三四万人。
这里面十二岁到十四岁的少男少女接近万人。
剩下的都是家眷仆从之类的。
“看来拜入宗门也没有自己想象的那么简单啊…”
“听说去年大夏剑宗拜宗之人多达一万八千余人，最后只有接近百人被收为弟子。”
“这灵根测试可谓是难倒了许多人哦…”
“对了…我是个啥灵根？”
然而就在李观棋一边向上疾驰一边发呆的时候，身旁竟是有一道身形消瘦的少年与他并驾齐驱。
那人一身白衣，腰间挂玉，速度极快。
在经过他身旁的时候，还不忘发出一声讥讽的嗤笑声。
李观棋眉头微皱，他看对方也不像是锻体境的人，为何速度会这么快？
可紧接着李观棋就看到了少年双足之下沾着的两道清风符！
清风符，不用任何灵力便可催动的篆符。

将其贴在脚下，则行动起来犹如乘风一般迅捷。
不过这玩意价格不菲，换算凡间钱财也要黄金万两。
至于他自己，连半个字儿的盘缠都没有，更别说购买这种东西了。
李观棋摇了摇头，开始调节自己的呼吸和步幅，他不知道上面还有多少台阶，他要尽可能的保持体力。
当他来到千级阶梯的时候，发现这时候已经有不少人体力不支坐下来休息了。

When Li Guanqi stepped onto the first step, he immediately attracted the attention of many people.
The young man carrying a huge box behind his back stepped onto the stairs without any hesitation.
The black strips of cloth covering the young man's eyes made everyone look sideways.
The steward, who had been keeping his eyes down and silent, suddenly opened his eyes and looked at the figure on the steps.
In his opinion, the stone box behind the young man weighed at least two hundred kilograms!
But this young man's breath was very even from beginning to end, without any effort.
The steward's eyes suddenly flashed with a gleam of light and he murmured.
"Such a physique...I'm afraid he has entered the realm of body training."
Phew!
A slight sound of breaking through the air sounded in the young man's ears, and his feet instantly exerted force and his body suddenly moved sideways by one foot.
"Huh?"
Li Guanqi stood on the steps and bowed in the direction of the steward: "Um... what did this senior want to do just now?"
The steward's smile became even wider when he saw the young man's swift skills.
"Don't be afraid, little baby, it's just a timing charm."
Li Guanqi scratched his head in embarrassment. It turned out to be a timing charm.
The steward circled his fingers, and the yellow talisman circled around Li Guanqi and finally stuck to his chest.
The steward smiled and said: "Go, hurry up, the sooner you go, the better."
Li Guanqi suddenly raised the corners of his mouth slightly, and quickly replied with cupped fists and a salute.
"Thank you to the steward, and the boy will go up first."
The steward opened his mouth and was about to say something, but saw the young man take a deep breath, exert force under his feet and gallop upwards like a cheetah!
"Hiss... Such a physique! I even want him to take off the things behind him."
Along the way, figures kept flashing past Li Guanqi, falling behind him.
Li Guanqi lowered his head to look at the dissipating spell on his chest, and estimated in his mind the time it would take for the spell to disappear.
"Two hours..."
"This endless ladder has thousands of steps at least, so it's not an easy task."
He had just reached halfway up the mountain at the foot of the mountain, and had walked for nearly three hours.
There are really too many people who come to worship the sect. A rough calculation shows that there are at least close to 30,000 to 40,000 people at the foot of the mountain of Daxia Sword Sect.
There are nearly 10,000 boys and girls between the ages of twelve and fourteen.
The rest are family members and servants.
"It seems that joining the sect is not as easy as I thought..."
"I heard that the Great Xia Sword Sect had more than 18,000 worshipers last year, but in the end only close to a hundred were accepted as disciples."
"This spiritual root test has stumped many people..."
"By the way...what kind of spiritual root am I?"
However, just as Li Guanqi was galloping upward in a daze, there was a thin young man running alongside him.
The man was dressed in white, with a jade hanging from his waist, and he was extremely fast.
When passing by him, he did not forget to let out a sarcastic laugh.
Li Guanqi frowned slightly. He didn't think the other party was in the physical training realm. Why was he so fast?
But then Li Guanqi saw two breeze charms stuck under the young man's feet!
The Qingfeng Talisman is a seal talisman that can be activated without any spiritual power.
If you attach it to your feet, you will move as fast as riding the wind.
However, this thing is expensive, and it costs ten thousand taels of gold when converted into mortal money.
As for himself, he didn't even have the money to pay for it, let alone buy such a thing.
Li Guanqi shook his head and began to adjust his breathing and stride. He didn't know how many steps there were, and he wanted to maintain his strength as much as possible.
When he came to the thousand steps, he found that many people were exhausted and sat down to rest.
